text:
amanda: Heads-up — periodic access review going out today. Owners need to confirm admin entitlements by EOD next Friday (link: https://go/review-sheet). Please mark 'keep' or 'demote' for any admin roles you own.

ravi: noted. quick flag: while pulling owner lists I saw an abnormal spike in KMS grant events last month. 83 grants over 24h for svc-prod-analytics — can someone from infra confirm if that's expected?

jordan: whoa 83? that sounds like the support elevation flow. last week's incident had a noisy retry loop, iirc. @lee did we root-cause that?

lee: yeah that was the support helper lambda that retried on 429s and re-issued grants. fixed the retry backoff yesterday. i already revoked the duplicated grants and left one canonical grant per session.

maria: fyi, during the incident we had one temporary admin elevation that didn't auto-revert because the auditbot missed the completion webhook. i've attached the error we saw: `Webhook failed: 502 Bad Gateway`

ravi: thanks @lee @maria. can we get a quick correlation between the KMS grant timestamps and the access-review owner list so we can exclude temporary elevations from the demotion run? otherwise the automation will try to demote and cause noisy alerts. suggested query: 
```
SELECT grant_id, created_at, principal, requestor, reason
FROM kms_grants
WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-01'
  AND principal LIKE 'svc-%'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 200;
```

amanda: good call. ops: will the scheduled demotion job exclude grants younger than 14 days? we should avoid demoting recent temporary fixes.

access-bot: Scheduled demotion job "admin-prune-run" will run 2026-04-05T02:00Z. Current config: keep grants with created_at >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days'.

jordan: 7 days feels short given our incident cadence. recommend 14 days for this run and add a one-time whitelist for principals with incident tags.

lee: +1 for 14 days. also propose we add a postmortem hook: when an incident creates temp elevations, attach `incident_id` to the grant and mark `auto_demote=false` for 30 days. small schema change but easy.

maria: can someone own the follow-up? i can open a quick PR to add incident_id to grants and update the webhook to set the flag.

ravi: i'll take ownership of the exclusion query and will produce a filter list for the demotion job by Wednesday. amanda — want me to slack the list to you before the run?

amanda: yes please. also small ops ask: include a column in the review sheet for "temporary elevation (Y/N)" so owners can mark it manually if automation misses something. :white_check_mark:

access-bot: Note: job config change request received. To change grace window to 14 days, send PR to infra/tools/admin-prune with label `prune-grace-14d`.

ravi: will do. last item — vuln triage link: i noticed one package flagged as high severity that requires a service account key rotation. i'll post details in #security-vuln after this thread.

amanda: awesome. thanks everyone. plan: (1) relax demotion window to 14d, (2) exclude incident-tagged grants, (3) revoke duplicate grants from last week (lee), (4) ravi to produce demotion filter by Wed, (5) maria to PR incident_id + flag. follow-ups scheduled in cal sync.

jordan: ack. if anyone needs me to pause the demotion job momentarily, ping and i'll hold it. :hand:
